settings.title: Absolutely adorable
settings.text: This book is absolutely adorable!!! My three year old loves it! The story is heartwarming and the illustrations are excellent!! Highly recommend for your kiddos!!
settings.author: Kathryn

settings.title: Perfect read-aloud rhythm
settings.text: As a mom to a 2 year old, we were SO excited to read this book. I really appreciate how it rhymes and has a great rhythm when I read it out loud. The illustrations are adorable and my son just loves pointing to each animal to tell me the sounds they make. It’s got a great message to it and I highly recommend it to anyone with littles (especially if they love farm animals)!
settings.author: Kelsey

settings.title: We read it over and over
settings.text: I purchased the book for my grandson and it is excellent! Very colorful, lots of farm animals that he loves and a good story! We read it over and over again!
settings.author: Jane

settings.title: Perfect just the way they are
settings.text: This book is perfect for little ones that are exploring their talents. It creates a sense that everyone is perfect just the way they are, and the way they were created to be!
settings.author: Ashley

settings.title: Fantastic message
settings.text: This book is great. The message and the illustrations are fantastic. My grandson loves the book. I hope there will be more books in the future!
settings.author: Chandra

settings.title: You can be brave
settings.text: Well written book for 2-5 years old. Teaches children being themselves is a good thing and no matter who you are, you can be brave.
settings.author: Sandra
